name: Floating Awesome Button (Sticky Button, Popup, Toast) & 200+ Website Custom Interactive Element
author: Artistudio

sections.description:
For any website owner, getting more conversions means turning visitors into customers. A Floating Awesome Button (FAB) is a great way to do this. Think of it as a helpful, interactive button that follows your visitors as they browse your site. It keeps important actions, right in front of them, no matter where they scroll.

Here’s why a FAB is so effective:

  • It’s always visible. Unlike a button that’s stuck at the bottom of a page, a FAB stays on the screen. This makes it easy for visitors to click whenever they’re ready to take an action.
  • It grabs attention. A FAB uses eye-catching elements like a popup or toast to deliver a message at the perfect moment. For example, you can show a special offer just as a visitor is about to leave your site.
  • It’s versatile. You can use a FAB for many different goals. You could add a sticky button for a “Contact Us” form, a popup for an email signup, or a toast notification to announce a new product.

🤩 Social media links & buttons

A great way to connect with your audience and make your website more useful is by using social media links and buttons. These are small, clickable icons or text buttons that let your visitors do all sorts of things, like follow you on social media, get in touch with you, or even buy your products.

Your website can use these buttons for many purposes. Here’s a simple breakdown of what they can do:

  • Connect on Social Media: These buttons are for your main social media profiles. With a single click, your visitors can go to your page on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube. This makes it easy for them to follow you and stay updated.
  • Communicate Instantly: These buttons help your visitors get in touch with you right away. For example, you can add a WhatsApp button for customer questions, a Phone button for direct calls, or an Email button to open a new message draft.
  • Improve Website Navigation: These buttons make your site easier to use. For instance, a Scroll to Top button lets visitors quickly get back to the top of a long page, a Print button helps them print an article, or a Latest Post button takes them to your newest content.

🍞 Toast Notifications & Alerts

A Toast notification is a simple, quick message that pops up on a website for a short time and then disappears on its own. Think of it like a small alert that “toasts” up from the corner of the screen to give a visitor some fast information without getting in their way.

Here’s a breakdown of the different ways you can use these helpful alerts:

  • Promotions and Offers: You can use a toast to let people know about special deals or new content. For example, a Download Ebook Toast can offer a free guide, a Free Consultation Toast can invite a visitor to a meeting, or a Latest Post Toast can highlight your newest blog article.
  • Special Events and Holidays: Toasts are perfect for celebrating with your audience. You can have a Happy Holiday Toast during the festive season, an April Fools’ Day Toast for a fun joke, or a World Environment Day Toast to show your support for a cause.
  • User-Specific Messages: You can make your website feel more personal by showing toasts only to certain people. A Welcome Toast for Registered User can greet a customer by name, while other toasts can be set to only appear on Desktop or Mobile devices.

🎯 Popup Features

A popup is a special window that appears on top of your website’s main content. Unlike a simple toast notification, a popup is designed to get your visitor’s full attention. It’s a great tool for making sure your most important messages are seen.

Here’s a look at the different kinds of popups you can use to improve your website:

  • Promotional Popups: These are perfect for special offers. You can use a Discount Popup to show a coupon code, a Limited Time Offer Popup to create a sense of urgency, or a Popup eBook to get visitors to sign up for your newsletter in exchange for a free download.
  • User-Friendly Popups: Popups can also make your website easier to use. A Search Popup gives visitors a quick way to find what they’re looking for, a Login Popup lets users sign in without leaving the page they’re on, and a Social Sharing Popup makes it easy for them to share your content.
  • Behavior-Based Popups: These are popups that appear at just the right moment. For instance, a Popup Exit Intent will only show up when a visitor is about to leave your site, giving you one last chance to grab their attention with a special offer. You can also set a Popup Time Delay to have a popup appear after a few seconds, once a visitor has had a chance to read your content.

🛒 WooCommerce Features

The features in this list are all about making your store more effective and easier to manage. They help you sell more products and improve the shopping experience for your customers.

Here’s a simple look at what these features can do for your store:

  • Make Buying Easy: These features simplify the buying process for your customers. For example, a WooCommerce Add to Cart button lets shoppers instantly add a product to their cart, while a WooCommerce Buy Now button lets them skip the cart and go straight to checkout.
  • Run Smart Promotions: You can use these features to create all kinds of sales and deals. A WooCommerce Apply Coupon button can automatically give a discount to loyal customers or those who have made a certain number of orders. You can also use a popup to announce that you have a WooCommerce Products On Sale Popup.
  • Keep Customers Informed: These features keep your shoppers updated with important information. A WooCommerce Scarcity Toast can alert customers that a product is almost sold out, while a WooCommerce Popup for Out of Stock Products can prevent them from trying to buy an unavailable item.
  • Boost Sales with Smart Suggestions: You can encourage customers to buy more by showing them products they might like. For instance, a WooCommerce Popup Smart Cross-Sells can suggest a related product (like a phone case for a phone they just added to their cart), and a WooCommerce Bestsellers Popup can show them what other people are buying.
  • Help Customers Remember Things: These features help customers complete their purchase. A WooCommerce Cart Reminder can remind a shopper about the items they left in their cart, and a WooCommerce Welcome Popup for New Customers can give them a friendly greeting when they first visit your store.

sections.faq:
What is a Floating Awesome Button (FAB) and why should I use it?

A Floating Awesome Button (FAB) is like having a friendly, always-visible helper on your website that visitors can click anytime. Think of it as a smart button that stays in view while people browse your pages, making it super easy for them to take important actions.

This plugin comes with over 50 ready-to-use website features that help turn visitors into customers. You can add things like:
– Eye-catching buttons that follow as people scroll
– Attractive pop-up messages that appear at just the right time
– Quick notification messages that slide into view
– And many more engaging elements that get people’s attention

The best part? These features are exactly what today’s website visitors expect and love to use. Whether you want people to contact you, sign up for newsletters, follow your social media, or take any other action – FAB makes it simple and natural for them to do so. Website owners who use FAB often see more people engaging with their content and taking desired actions, which means better results for their business.

What’s the difference between floating action buttons or other conversion buttons?

With FAB, you get smart control over where and how your buttons appear. You can create targeted buttons that only show on specific pages using “location rules”, customize visibility for mobile and desktop users, style buttons with your own icons and colors, add social sharing options, set buttons to appear during business hours, and much more.

The real magic happens with FAB’s group button feature – one main button can expand to reveal multiple action buttons customized for that specific page.

FAB makes your website more interactive and engaging, encouraging visitors to take action in ways that feel natural and intuitive. The result? A more dynamic website that drives better results.

Does FAB work on mobile?

Yes, FAB works on all devices, including mobile phones and tablets. The button will be displayed on the right side of the screen, regardless of the device type.

Usage Tracking (What Is Tracked & Why)

Are you curious about usage tracking in Floating Awesome Button (FAB)? Usage tracking helps our team to better understand our users and their website needs by looking at a range of variables in their FAB plugins, WordPress, and web host.

This information allows us to continuously improve our product as well as our QA/testing process. In this article, we’ve shared the details that FAB collects through usage tracking and why we track this information.

Below is the list of information that FAB collects as part of the usage tracking:

Floating Awesome Button
– Versions and activation status of FAB plugins – So we know which versions of FAB are potentially responsible for issues when we get bug reports, allowing us to identify issues and release solutions much faster.
– License details & activation status (paid customers only) – if you’re a FAB customer, then we use this to determine if there’s an issue with your specific license key, and to link the profile of your site with the configuration to allow us to determine if there’s issues with your FAB configuration.
– FAB plugin settings – Know which settings people are using allows us to determine potentially which new settings or areas of FAB people want us to expand on, and which settings people aren’t using so we can make the interfaces more streamlined and usable.
– Usage tracking config – The FAB option that contains the information on when the usage tracking data-sync will happen (once a week), so we can gauge the server load for the usage tracking servers.
– Effectiveness stats – Anonymized statistical data relating to the effectiveness of button placement, popup engagement, and feature usage. This data is viewed in aggregate and not personally identifiable to your site.

WordPress
– Theme/Plugin names and versions – So we know which themes and plugins to support and test against. FAB runs on thousands of websites. While we can’t test with all 50,000+ plugins in the WordPress universe, we do our best to test against the top plugins and themes from this list.
– Site and user count and is multisite – This allows us to gauge how important it is to support specific types of multisites like multi-network and similar styles of configuration and gauge how much we need to scale our servers before launching features. Knowing the sub-site count helps us ensure FAB scales properly for large networks.
– Locale – We want FAB to be accessible to everyone, and knowing the site’s locale helps us focus our translation efforts.
– Timezone – We have users across the globe, so knowing the densities within various time zones helps us provide the best support coverage possible.
– Site URL – The website address allows us to properly store usage tracking records so that we can avoid duplicated details.
– WordPress versions – knowing which versions of WordPress our customers are using helps us better tune compatibility with differences in those particular versions. It also helps us identify gaps in our testing/QA processes.

Server
– PHP and MySQL Versions – These details help us make sure our testing procedures have proper coverage to avoid compatibility issues.
– Server Software – This reports if the web server software is Apache, Nginx, or similar, which is used for testing purposes.
